findings.evidence: The retained-content criterion (accepted values, max hardest-single-task, ultra multiplier/double weight/never-default/unproven vs max) is HOST-inspected only. The Select-String block checks just 3 forbidden and 3 required phrases.
findings.summary: Retention of the required prose is not mechanically checked, so an over-deletion by the coder would pass the scripted checks. HOST inspection covers it, so this is minor. Optionally add SimpleMatch required checks such as 'double', 'head-to-head', and 'max_parallel_codex'.
